scope: Read-only visual review of completed fd7 Windows presentation output. Curated images are byte-exact ScreenCapture originals, with no image edits or substituted native renders.
verdict: No new blocking visual defect observed in this captured presentation set. Automated candidate gates passed; promotion/publication remain lead decisions.

reviewMethod.all62: Viewed every image in eight final labelled contact sheets, plus direct originals for the critical subjects below. Contact sheets are derived QA aids under Logs, not curated evidence originals.

venueObservations.TruckAvalancheEscape: Snow course, actual trucks and participant/time context present in shared and split views.
venueObservations.TruckCornhole: All shared/cab cases populated. Direct shared720/1080 show focused exterior fully in frame, attached wheels and clear board/hole. Cab views retain their intentional first-person ownership; no exterior requirement imposed on cabs.
venueObservations.TruckDockDiving: Original replay scene and actual banked score/distance presentation visible.
venueObservations.TruckFieldGoal: Recorded selected hotdog visible on stadium replay screen; typed recorded ownership evidence reports source0 to ghost0 hierarchy/mesh/material/paint agreement with 50 matching visible meshes. Hidden live source is intentional Replay state.
venueObservations.TruckFloorIsLava: Visible selected bodies/platforms and actual participant cards present in both layouts. Zero-scale invisible-fragment probe issue is separate from visible rendering; no runtime camera change was needed.
venueObservations.TruckGiantSwing: Current pumping state and original vehicle/course present; capture is not a completed-attempt claim.
venueObservations.TruckNinjaWarrior: Direct720/1080 show selected hotdog truck on actual tilting-step platform; participant/current-course/time text readable. Early-state capture is not course completion.
venueObservations.TruckRedLightGreenLight: Course signals and actual phase/participant progress display present; captured green and imminent-red states differ naturally.
venueObservations.TruckSkyTow: One-to-four actual AI view counts and shared view populated after original restart flow. One shared720 frame has a nearby foreground ring crossing much of the scene; shared1080 is clear. No new blocker concluded from this transient course occlusion.
venueObservations.TruckTargetLaunch: Target rings, selected vehicles, wind/current-state readouts and bright lava presentation visible. No natural lava fracture observed in the separate appearance sample; remains UNVERIFIED_NOT_OBSERVED.
venueObservations.TruckVolleyball: Actual court, ball and team scorebug present in shared and AI views; no touches/hits debug panel observed.
venueObservations.TruckWhackAMole: Actual moles/course, participant points and remaining-time/context cards present in shared and split views.
venueObservations.TruckBungeeDemolition: Actual dangling truck and subsequent award state populated; existing wide city split-view composition retained.

supplementalAppearanceDirectReview.review: Direct original inspected. Four actual feeds populated; retro dark/stippled palette retains ramps, rings and selected-truck detail, with crisp HUD. These images are not part of the 62 presentation images.

Direct original inspected. Four actual feeds populated; retro dark/stippled palette retains ramps, rings and selected-truck detail, with crisp HUD. These images are not part of the 62 presentation images.

nativeWindowsDistinction.native49: Separate controlled native proof: eight natural original shared/cab cases, 77/77 primary exterior samples and 32032/32032 primary corners; not Windows or physical-human evidence. Its controlled PNGs remain separately labelled native49-...-controlled.
nativeWindowsDistinction.native46: Valid prior camera failure retained: shared primary clipping14/19,14/19,14/19,15/20 samples. Corrected miniature body fits alone did not remove that spectator framing defect.
nativeWindowsDistinction.currentWindows: Current fd7 Windows originals visibly confirm corrected miniature body/wheel fit and focused spectator composition. These images have later live capture ages and are not reused Native49 images.
nativeWindowsDistinction.earlierFailures: Prior 4c runtime-restart failure, f2 probe-assertion failures and246 visually rejected Cornhole captures remain historical evidence; passing counters did not overwrite those failures.

limits: Original AI and backbuffer captures do not constitute physical-human/controller/wheel-input, listening, performance/FPS/GPU, profile-soak or full-match acceptance.
Natural Target lava fracture remains UNVERIFIED_NOT_OBSERVED (one separate appearance sample, zero observed lava contacts).
Derby retains an honest original-sport-truck fallback; it is outside this thirteen-scene presentation set.
Bear and excluded Plow/Cab Chaos requirements are not validated by these runs.
Screenshots sample current moments; they do not prove every possible animation, camera pose or match outcome.

curatedWindowsOriginals.caption: ACTUAL WINDOWS D3D11: original four-AI natural flight, focused red miniature truck fully within frame with wheel visuals adjoining the body and target board/hole visible. Other airborne trucks provide context. This is a later live capture than the controlled Native49 frame.

ACTUAL WINDOWS D3D11: original Field Goal replay shows the recorded hotdog truck on the stadium screen, with real attempt score, 33-yard distance and replay state. Live source is intentionally hidden during replay; typed evidence reports 50 matching recorded selected-model meshes.
ACTUAL WINDOWS D3D11: one-owner SkyTow view after the original count/restart sequence, showing the truck, cable, boat, rings and snowy harbor. Captured current state; no completed-match claim.
ACTUAL WINDOWS D3D11: selected hotdog truck on the current tilting-step course, with actual participant cards and running clock. Captured early current state; no course-completion claim.
